current_safe_publication.mechanism: existing profile-bound Manager-v2 source proxy plus fixed E5 operation adapter
current_safe_publication.canary: Portal composition over Live facts; no direct Manager Canary profile
current_safe_publication.continuation: source-issued opaque cursor, bound to named relation and profile

publication_order: Portal BFF selects exactly one frozen E5 field operation
Edge binds the profile-bound Manager authority and verifies the current catalogue relation
Manager-v2 returns one bounded current/range page with source envelope
Edge reduces only the frozen allowlisted response fields and preserves source freshness/completeness/as-of
Portal renders the typed result or source-owner gap without inferring replay/history

source_owner_work.authoritative_event_journal: required before event.full-incremental, durable replay, global sequence, retention floor or correction capability
source_owner_work.market_context: requires typed bounded Data Layer/market contracts for each currently absent market capability
source_owner_work.artifact_and_research: requires signed-reference and stable research-linkage contract, never arbitrary storage access
source_owner_work.command: separate command activation and terminal-evidence exercise; not enabled by this read return pack

release_boundary: E7 is contract/evidence-only. Binding the E5 adapter to a deployed Portal BFF is a separately approved immutable-image/change-window release, with the compatibility matrix and rollback procedure in this pack.
